title: Phase 3 Study of Osimertinib vs Placebo in EGFR-Mutated NSCLC After Complete Tumor Resection (ADAURA2)
inclusion_summary: Completely resected stage IB-IIIA NSCLC with confirmed EGFR exon 19 del or L858R. ECOG 0-1. Adequate organ function.
exclusion_summary: Prior EGFR-TKI therapy. Uncontrolled interstitial lung disease. Active second malignancy.
intervention: Osimertinib 80mg PO daily vs placebo x3 years

title: FLAURA: First-Line Osimertinib vs Gefitinib/Erlotinib in EGFR-Mutated Advanced NSCLC
inclusion_summary: Treatment-naive locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR sensitizing mutation. ECOG 0-1.
exclusion_summary: Prior systemic therapy for advanced disease. Symptomatic brain metastases untreated.

title: AURA3: Osimertinib vs Platinum-Pemetrexed in T790M-Positive NSCLC After EGFR-TKI Failure
inclusion_summary: Confirmed T790M mutation after progression on prior EGFR-TKI. ECOG 0-1.
exclusion_summary: Prior treatment with third-generation EGFR-TKI. Leptomeningeal carcinomatosis.

title: Amivantamab + Lazertinib vs Osimertinib in EGFR-Mutated NSCLC (MARIPOSA)
inclusion_summary: First-line treatment of EGFR-mutated locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC. ECOG 0-1.
exclusion_summary: Prior systemic therapy for metastatic disease. Uncontrolled cardiovascular disease.

title: Amivantamab Monotherapy in EGFR Exon 20 Insertion-Mutated NSCLC (PAPILLON)
inclusion_summary: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion. No prior systemic therapy for advanced disease.
exclusion_summary: Prior amivantamab or other EGFR/c-MET bispecific. Active ILD.

title: CodeBreaK 200: Sotorasib vs Docetaxel in Previously Treated KRAS G12C-Mutated NSCLC
inclusion_summary: KRAS G12C mutation confirmed. Prior platinum-based chemotherapy and/or anti-PD-(L)1. ECOG 0-1.
exclusion_summary: Prior KRAS G12C inhibitor. Active brain metastases requiring steroids.

title: ALEX: Alectinib vs Crizotinib in Untreated ALK-Positive NSCLC
inclusion_summary: ALK rearrangement positive by FISH or NGS. No prior ALK inhibitor. ECOG 0-2.
exclusion_summary: Prior crizotinib or other ALK-TKI. Pregnancy.

title: CheckMate 227: Nivolumab + Ipilimumab vs Chemotherapy in PD-L1-Positive NSCLC
inclusion_summary: Stage IV or recurrent NSCLC. PD-L1 TPS >= 1%. No EGFR or ALK genomic tumor aberrations. ECOG 0-1.
exclusion_summary: Active autoimmune disease requiring systemic treatment. Prior immunotherapy.

title: KEYNOTE-024: Pembrolizumab vs Chemotherapy in PD-L1 High NSCLC (TPS >= 50%)
inclusion_summary: PD-L1 TPS >= 50%. No EGFR or ALK alterations. No prior systemic therapy for metastatic disease.

title: PACIFIC: Durvalumab After Chemoradiation in Unresectable Stage III NSCLC
inclusion_summary: Unresectable stage III NSCLC. Completed concurrent platinum-based chemoradiation without progression. ECOG 0-1.
exclusion_summary: Progression during chemoradiation. Active autoimmune disease.

title: CHRYSALIS-2: Amivantamab + Chemotherapy in EGFR Exon 20 Insertion NSCLC After Prior Therapy
inclusion_summary: EGFR exon 20 insertion. Progression on or after platinum chemotherapy. ECOG 0-1.

title: Neoadjuvant Osimertinib in Resectable EGFR-Mutated NSCLC (NeoADAURA)
inclusion_summary: Resectable stage II-IIIB EGFR-mutated NSCLC. No prior systemic anti-cancer therapy. ECOG 0-1.
exclusion_summary: Unresectable disease. Prior EGFR-TKI. M1 disease.
intervention: Neoadjuvant osimertinib 80mg x8 weeks then surgery

title: Capmatinib in MET Exon 14 Skipping Mutated Advanced NSCLC (GEOMETRY mono-1)
inclusion_summary: MET exon 14 skipping or MET amplification. ECOG 0-2.
exclusion_summary: Prior MET inhibitor. Symptomatic untreated CNS metastases.

title: Entrectinib in ROS1/NTRK/ALK-Positive Advanced NSCLC
inclusion_summary: ROS1 fusion positive. ECOG 0-2. Prior chemotherapy allowed.
exclusion_summary: Prior ROS1 TKI (for TKI-naive cohort). Fructose intolerance.

title: Selpercatinib in RET Fusion-Positive Advanced NSCLC (LIBRETTO-431)
inclusion_summary: RET fusion positive. Treatment-naive for advanced disease. ECOG 0-1.
exclusion_summary: Prior selective RET inhibitor. Uncontrolled hypertension.
